description: This file defines schema configuration for Keystone 6, including lists for Post, Author, and Tag, each with fields, access controls, and UI search configurations.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Defines a new list schema for Keystone with specified fields, access, and UI options.

methods.name: allowAll
methods.description: Access control that permits all operations (create, read, update, delete).

methods.name: text
methods.description: Defines a text field with optional validation.

methods.name: relationship
methods.description: Defines a relationship field referencing other lists, with optional 'many' relation.
